{{Quote|What is it?''"<br />"''Pain&hellip; Suffering&hellip; ''Death,'' I feel. Something terrible has happened. Young Skywalker is in pain. ''Terrible'' pain.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|<ref name="aotc" />}}
A '''mission''' to Tatooine took place shortly before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the first battle of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. After the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] gave [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] a mission to protect [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], Skywalker had a dream of his mother suffering and both Skywalker and Amidala left Naboo to go to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to find his mother, [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker Lars]]. Skywalker received information of Shmi's whereabouts from his old [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]], [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], and soon Skywalker met the [[Lars family/Legends|Lars family]], who bought Shmi from Watto, and discovered she had been kidnapped by a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] raiding party and was believed dead. After much investigation, Skywalker tracked his mother, who was extremely weak after a month of [[Torture/Legends|torture]], who then [[Death/Legends|died]] in his arms. Consumed by rage, the young Jedi touched the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and massacred nearly the entire village, killing every male, female, and child he could find, and paid no attention to the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], who spoke to Skywalker in an attempt to prevent the carnage, while [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] felt Anakin's grief grow darker as the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] meditated in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].

Skywalker returned to the Lars Homestead with his mother's body in his arms. The Lars family, [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]]&mdash;[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], Skywalker and Amidala [[Funeral of Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|buried]] Skywalker's mother near the Homestead and paid their respects. Enraged, he told Padmé Amidala of the massacre and showed no mercy to the Tuskens. He blamed the death of his mother on his master, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who had taught him to be mindful of his thoughts and dreams of his mother would pass in time. Skywalker's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], arrived during the funeral to alert Skywalker and Amidala of Kenobi's transmission from [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. C-3PO accompanied Skywalker, Amidala, and R2 and left Tatooine for Geonosis on Amidala's personal [[H-type Nubian yacht/Legends|yacht]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I saw my mother. She is suffering, Padmé. I saw her as clearly as I see you now. She is in pain. I know I'm disobeying my mandate to protect you, Senator, but I have to go. I have to help her!''"<br />"''I'll go with you.''"<br />"''I'm sorry, I don't have a choice.|Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala|<ref name="aotc" />}}
After his departure from his mother, [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker Lars]], on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], young [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] couldn't let go of his attachment for his mother. The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] saw this within Skywalker when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] had brought him to the Jedi, due to his high [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|Midi-chlorian]] count and believed that Skywalker was the [[Chosen One/Legends|Chosen One]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] that will destroy the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and bring balance to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Prior to Jinn's [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|death]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], Jinn told his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to train Skywalker in the ways of the Jedi. The Jedi Council promoted Kenobi to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knighthood]] and agreed with Jinn's request&mdash;Skywalker became Kenobi's Padawan.<ref name="pm">{{Film|I}}</ref>

[[File:AnakinDream-AOTC.png|thumb|left|200px|Anakin Skywalker having nightmares of his mother suffering.]]
[[22 BBY/Legends|Ten years]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], Kenobi and Skywalker were called to protect the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] from Naboo, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. Following her arrival on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Amidala was involved in a [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|plot to kill her]], which was conducted by two [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]]. Skywalker, who had not seen Amidala since the Invasion of Naboo, was intoxicated by her presence and endured a sense of attachment. While Kenobi assured his apprentice that a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] must not become attached, Skywalker was having problems with his attachment to his mother; who he had not seen for ten years. Kenobi knew of Skywalker's problem with attachments and encouraged his apprentice that the dreams of his mother would pass in time.<ref name="aotc" />

The plot to assassinate Senator Amidala caused turmoil within the Jedi Council, who had sent Kenobi to the lost [[Wild Space/Legends|wild space]] planet of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to track one of the two bounty hunters that were responsible for the threat against Amidala's life. The council had given Skywalker a mission to protect Amidala and transport her to her home planet of Naboo. As his attachment for Amidala grew on Naboo, dreams of his mother worsened and soon one night, he had a nightmare of her suffering. Skywalker insisted that he should return to Tatooine to find his mother, which disobeyed Kenobi's request for Skywalker to stay on Naboo and protect the senator. However, Amidala followed Skywalker and the two of them left for Tatooine on a mission to find his mother.<ref name="aotc" />

==The mission==
===The Lars Homestead===
{{Dialogue|Owen Lars|Owen Lars, this is my girlfriend, Beru.|Skywalker|Is my mother here?|Cliegg Lars|No she's not... Cliegg Lars, Shmi is my wife. You better come inside, we have a lot to talk about.|attr=Anakin Skywalker meeting the Lars family|src=<ref name="aotc" />}}
[[File:AnakinClieggOwen-AotC.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Anakin, Cliegg and Owen discuss about Shmi's disappearance.]]
Amidala and Skywalker entered the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]] on Amidala's personal [[H-type Nubian yacht/Legends|yacht]]. They landed in Skywalker's childhood town of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], which the two had not seen for ten years. Skywalker approached his old [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] master, [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] near his [[Wald's Parts|shop]]. Due to Skywalker's ten year absence, Watto did not recognize who the outlander was. The Jedi Padawan refreshed his former owner's memory by asking where his mother, Shmi, was. Surprised, Watto was thrilled to see his old [[Slavery/Legends|slave]]. Skywalker demanded to know the whereabouts of his mother, to which Watto informed him that he had sold her after Skywalker left Tatooine in 32 BBY. The Toydarian sold Shmi to a [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Lars family/Legends|family]] that lived near the city of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. Watto gave Anakin the location of Shmi and both Skywalker and Amidala departed Mos Espa.<ref name="aotc" />

The duo was greeted by Skywalker's old [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], who went with Shmi when she was sold by Watto and left Mos Espa. C-3PO took his former master into the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]], where Skywalker met the family who bought his mother. Young [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]] and his girlfriend, [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|Beru Whitesun]], greeted Skywalker and Amidala. The owner of the homestead, [[Cliegg Lars/Legends|Cliegg Lars]], approached Skywalker after he questioned Owen about his mother's whereabouts. The group went inside the homestead while Cliegg explained his relationship with Shmi. He bought Shmi from Watto after falling in love with her, freed her, and married her soon after.<ref name="aotc" />

One early morning, a group of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] stormed the homestead and took Shmi with them. Cliegg and his fellow moisture farmers began a search party, though only a few returned and Cliegg lost part of his right leg from an undisclosed incident while he searched for Shmi. Cliegg told Skywalker that he didn't want to lose hope, but she had been gone for a month.<ref name="aotc" />

Skywalker insisted that he would find his mother. However, Cliegg, without hesitation, told him that she was dead. Skywalker ignored him and prepared to leave the homestead, intent on searching for his mother. Amidala joined him outside and soon Skywalker departed on the Lars's [[Zephyr-G swoop/Legends|swoop bike]], determined to find his mother before it was too late.<ref name="aotc" />

===Reunion and massacre===
{{Quote|Ani? Is it you? Ani?''"<br />"''I'm here, Mom. you're safe.|Shmi Skywalker is reunited with Anakin Skywalker before her death|audio=AnakinShmiDeath.flac|<ref name="aotc" />}}
[[File:Valley_and_Anakin.png|thumb|left|200px|Anakin overlooking the Tusken camp]]
The voyage to find his mother proved to be a challenge for Skywalker. He received information from a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] about a [[Valley of the Spirits|Tusken camp]] not far from his location.<ref name="aotc" /> On the way, he stopped to find three farmers massacred by the Tuskens but decided he would have to bury them later; his [[Force sense/Legends|senses]] gave him a direction to where his mother's suffering would be found.<ref name="aotc novel">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref> Skywalker continued on and stopped near the edge of a cliff. The young Jedi saw a Tusken camp barely illuminated by its campfire and knew that his mother was there. Quietly, he proceeded towards one of the tents and used his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to cut a hole through the thick cloth that held the tent together.<ref name="aotc" />

Skywalker saw his injured mother who was tied to two wooden poles inside the tent he entered. Skywalker proceeded to free his mother and lowered her into his arms. Pleased to see her son, Shmi had a brief conversation with Skywalker. She weakly expressed that in seeing Anakin one last time, she was complete. Their talk ended when Shmi [[Death/Legends|died]] from her injuries in her son's arms.<ref name="aotc" />

[[File:AnoTRbeheah1.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The massacre begins with the death of a Tusken guard]]
Enraged, Skywalker left his mother's body in the tent, ignited his lightsaber, and killed the two Tuskens guarding the tent. The sound of the lightsaber alerted more Tuskens who were nearby which caused them to attack Skywalker, flanking several [[Massiff/Legends|Massiffs]] as they launched their attack. However, the Jedi showed no mercy and proceeded in his Tusken massacre,<ref name="aotc" /> [[Force jump/Legends|empowering his jumps]] and [[Force speed/Legends|speed]] with the Force and telekinetically slamming (such as sending one soldier crashing along for thirty meters) and throwing rocks at his victims, even at one point mentally collapsing a tent. For a moment at the end, the furious slaughter made him feel more alive and connected to the Force than he had ever been before.<ref name="aotc novel" /> He did not stop until the entire camp was silent and every man, woman, and child in his path was destroyed.<ref name="aotc" />

The [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], tried to calm Skywalker in an attempt to prevent the carnage, but it was in vain;<ref name="aotc" /> Skywalker's agony and rage were so great that he did not recognize the late Jedi Master's voice.<ref name="aotc novel" /> On Coruscant, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] heard Jinn's voice through the Force and felt Skywalker's pain, and also told [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] when he asked about it.<ref name="aotc" />

===Return to the Homestead===
{{Quote|I... I killed them. I killed them all. They're dead, every single one of them. And not just the men, but the women and the children too. They're like animals, and I ''slaughtered'' them like animals. I ''hate'' them!|Anakin Skywalker telling Padmé Amidala of the massacre, expressing his hate for the Tusken Raiders.|<ref name="aotc" />}}
[[File:AnakinCarriesShmisBody-AOTC.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Anakin holding the body of his mother.]]
Skywalker returned to the homestead on the swoop he left with. Shmi's body was wrapped in a large piece of cloth. The Lars family and Amidala, whom thought she could not be found, were shocked to see Skywalker with his mother's body. Cliegg was one of the few who could not bear to look at the sight while Skywalker entered the homestead.<ref name="aotc" />

The rough moment for Skywalker turned when Amidala entered the room where Skywalker was inside the homestead. She tried to ask him of what happened and Skywalker revealed to Amidala of the massacre that he started. His hatred for Tuskens grew worse as he claimed that he slaughtered the Tuskens for the death of his mother. He blamed his master for not letting him find his mother during the ten year span of his absence from Tatooine. Skywalker soon became emotional and wept for his mother's loss.<ref name="aotc" />

Shortly after, Skywalker, the Lars family and Amidala [[Funeral of Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|buried]] Shmi outside, near the homestead. Skywalker assured his mother that he would not fail to protect another loved one again. During the funeral, Skywalker's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], approached the group. C-3PO told Skywalker that R2 had received a message from a person named Obi-Wan Kenobi and soon Skywalker, Amidala, and the droids left the homestead to listen to the message that Kenobi transmitted from [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], on Amidala's yacht.<ref name="aotc" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Remember what you told me about your mother and the Sand People?|[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="rots" />}}
Shortly after the Mission to Tatooine, Skywalker and Amidala endured on a rescue mission to release Kenobi, who was captured by former Jedi Master, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] on Geonosis. The [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the first battle in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], soon began after a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|Jedi Strike Team]] arrived, led by Mace Windu. Skywalker [[Wedding of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala/Legends|married]] Amidala after the Battle of Geonosis on Naboo and his attachment for Amidala grew more during the war.<ref name="aotc" />

During the Clone Wars, Skywalker became a Jedi Knight and took on a [[Mission to Jabba's Palace (Clone Wars)/Legends|mission]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> Skywalker thought he wouldn't return to Tatooine due to what had happened months prior to his return. It was painful for Skywalker to speak of his past and would not tell his Padawan, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who accompanied Skywalker during the mission.<ref name="tcw">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>

On Tatooine, various Tusken Raiders learned of the event, and came to refer to Anakin Skywalker as the "Demon Outlander," due to his butchery of the camp as well as his allegedly not being from Tatooine. They also conducted sacrifices to appease the "Demon Outlander."<ref name="Barely Tolerable 2" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], shortly after Skywalker [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|killed]] the Separatist leader, Count Dooku, over Coruscant, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], a close friend of Skywalker, when feigning sympathy for Skywalker's guilt for doing so, referenced Skywalker's massacre when mentioning it wasn't the first time the boy gave in to anger, due to Skywalker having earlier told him about the event. In addition, Skywalker had dreams of Amidala dying from childbirth. Palpatine had knowledge of the massacre and his marriage and soon this knowledge would play a role when Palpatine revealed himself to be Darth Sidious, though it is uncertain if the dark side had been involved in the killing of Shmi. When Mace Windu [[Showdown on Coruscant|dueled]] the Sith Lord on Coruscant, Skywalker was present at the time of the duel and saw Windu attempted to murder Sidious. Enraged and desperate, Skywalker severed Windu's lightsaber hand, and Sidious blasted Windu with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. With the knowledge of Amidala dying, Skywalker joined the dark side and became Darth Vader. After Vader's [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|duel]] with his former master, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Vader received life threatening injuries from the fires of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Sidious brought his apprentice back to Coruscant to be resurrected with the [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|suit]] he would wear for the rest of his life. Amidala soon died on [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]] after giving birth to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Amidala Skywalker]].<ref name="rots">{{Film|III}}</ref>

In large part because of the pain this event afflicted on Skywalker/Vader, as well as his past in general, Vader rarely ever visited Tatooine, which likewise resulted in Vader's son, Luke, growing up with minimal risk of ever encountering Vader on Tatooine.<ref name="DL:TRODV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref> In addition, when Vader successfully managed to [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|arrest]] Leia Amidala Skywalker, by that time going by the name of Leia Organa due to being separated at birth from her twin brother, he was largely displeased about the arrest occurring above Tatooine due to having lingering memories of the event.<ref name="SW:CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

Ultimately, only one survivor of Anakin's slaughter existed, [[KkH'Oar'Rrhr]], who had been bonding with his [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] at the time of the massacre. KkH'Oar'Rrhr would later end up working as a [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]] student of the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Arden Lyn]] and fight Luke Skywalker, under the belief that he was the "Demon Outlander," by [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="Barely Tolerable 2" />

[[8 ABY/Legends|29 years]] after the resulting massacre, Skywalker's daughter, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], and her husband [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] came to Tatooine for a mission to stop an auction that included an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] piece of art. However, their journey in Tatooine soon became a mission of learning the past. Leia's father, Anakin Skywalker, murdered a group of Tusken Raiders some 29 years prior to their mission, in a camp called Valley of the Spirits. Leia and Han traveled across the area and were consumed by wind like weather, possibly the spirits of the Tuskens.<ref name="tg">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Did you ever get any indication as to whether Palpatine was responsible for staging the Tusken attack on Shmi Skywalker in order to cause Anakin to begin faltering, and thus being more susceptible to Palpatine's influence?''"<br />"''My son and I were just talking about the Tuskens &hellip; I can't offer anything definitive, but I believe that Sidious's fingerprints are all over Shmi's abduction.|Paul and James Luceno|<ref name="eucantina" />}}
The mission first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones's'' novel]].<ref name="aotc" /> Anakin Skywalker's problems with attachments began when he left his mother in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']], and it became worse throughout his life as a Jedi.<ref name="pm" /> In [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], Anakin had dreams of his wife, Padmé Amidala, dying from childbirth. The image of Amidala dying in Anakin's dreams was shown on screen and would play a major part in Anakin's downfall to the dark side in ''Revenge of the Sith''.<ref name="rots" /> [[George Lucas]] has commented about Anakin and his dreams in the audio commentary of ''Revenge of the Sith'' DVD, stating that after he left Tatooine in Episode I, the pain of losing his mother would continue on in his Jedi life until her death in Episode II. While Anakin had matured much since then, he still had problems with attachments, which only worsened with his dreams of Padmé's death during childbirth in ''Revenge of the Sith''.<ref name="rotsdvd">{{Film|III}} DVD audio commentary</ref>

In an interview with eucantina.net, [[James Luceno]], one of the authors of the DK visual dictionary lines, implied that [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] was involved in the Tusken Raider's abduction of Shmi Skywalker as a means to ensure that Anakin would fall to the Dark Side.<ref name="eucantina">{{WebCite|url=http://www.eucantina.net/archives/11656#more-11656|archivedate=20130212142851|text=Transcript of James Luceno’s Facebook Fan Chat|date=2012-01-25|nolive=1}}</ref>

===Non-canon content===
[[1 ABY/Legends|23 years]] after the mission, Vader and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Tao (Sith Apprentice)|Tao]], encountered a [[KkH'Oar'Rrhr|vengeful Tusken Raider]] that belonged to the group of Tuskens that were murdered on Tatooine. The Tusken engaged Vader in a fight, and soon brought Vader to his knees. As an act of revenge, the Tusken claimed that Vader murdered his entire family that night in 22 BBY. The Tusken was about to kill Vader until Tao saved his master's life by killing the Tusken. Tao was injured and soon died in Vader's arms which caused Vader to [[Force scream/Legends|scream]] in rage.<ref name="evil">"[[Perfect Evil]]"</ref>
